ERR_COMM_DOWN.title: Inverter Communication Lost
ERR_COMM_DOWN.description: Communication link between Suryalogix data logger and the inverter has been interrupted.
ERR_COMM_DOWN.oem_definition: Logger detected RS485 / Modbus TCP timeout or CRC communication failure with inverter device.
potential_causes: RS485 communication cable disconnected, sheared, or loose terminals
Data logger power cycle or gateway reboot
Inverter auxiliary power supply offline
ERR_COMM_DOWN.recommended_action: Check RS485 wiring, logger terminal connections, and inverter control card power.

INV_STATUS_FAULT.title: Inverter General Fault
INV_STATUS_FAULT.description: Inverter reported critical error state and tripped offline.
INV_STATUS_FAULT.oem_definition: inverter_status register returned status code 5 indicating protection trip.
potential_causes: Internal hardware protection trip
Severe AC grid disturbance or short circuit
DC array ground isolation breakdown
INV_STATUS_FAULT.recommended_action: Check inverter LCD display or diagnostic registers for exact fault code, isolate AC/DC and inspect installation.

INV_STATUS_DERATING.title: Inverter Thermal or Power Derating
INV_STATUS_DERATING.description: Inverter active power output is throttled due to high temperature or curtailment limit.
INV_STATUS_DERATING.oem_definition: Inverter operating in derating mode (inverter_status = 6 or active_plimit > 0).
potential_causes: High heatsink temperature exceeding 75°C
Clogged external cooling fans or heat exchanger dust accumulation
Utility grid active power curtailment command
INV_STATUS_DERATING.recommended_action: Inspect cooling fans for debris, verify cabinet ventilation clearance, and check active power setpoint.

OVER_TEMP.title: Heatsink / Cabinet Over Temperature
OVER_TEMP.description: Power electronics heatsink or internal cabinet temperature exceeded safe operating threshold.
OVER_TEMP.oem_definition: TEMP_HS > 80°C or TEMP_INT > 70°C detected in telemetry.
potential_causes: Cooling fan failure or mechanical obstruction
Direct solar exposure on inverter cabinet without sunshade
Dust accumulation on heatsink fins
OVER_TEMP.recommended_action: Clean heatsink fins, test cooling fan rotation, and verify air intake filters.

GRID_OVER_VOLTAGE.title: Grid Overvoltage
GRID_OVER_VOLTAGE.description: Three-phase grid voltage exceeded inverter high voltage threshold.
GRID_OVER_VOLTAGE.oem_definition: AC line voltage exceeded statutory upper threshold.
potential_causes: Local distribution grid voltage surge
High impedance in AC cabling causing excessive voltage rise during peak generation
Transformer tap setting set too high
GRID_OVER_VOLTAGE.recommended_action: Inverter will auto-reconnect once grid voltage normalizes. Contact distribution utility if persistent.

GRID_UNDER_VOLTAGE.title: Grid Undervoltage / AC Blackout
GRID_UNDER_VOLTAGE.description: Utility grid voltage fell below minimum allowable operational limit.
GRID_UNDER_VOLTAGE.oem_definition: AC terminal voltage dropped below operational trip limit.
potential_causes: Utility grid outage or load shedding
Main AC circuit breaker or LT switchgear tripped
Loose AC terminal connection
GRID_UNDER_VOLTAGE.recommended_action: Check AC breaker position and inspect grid supply status.

PV_ISO_FAULT.title: PV Array Ground Isolation Fault
PV_ISO_FAULT.description: Insulation resistance between DC array conductors and earth is below the safety threshold.
PV_ISO_FAULT.oem_definition: DC insulation resistance measurement failed safe limit test prior to grid connection.
potential_causes: Damaged DC cable insulation touching metal module mounting structure
Water ingress in DC combiner box or MC4 connectors
Pinched wire during recent maintenance or cleaning
PV_ISO_FAULT.recommended_action: Test string insulation resistance to earth using 1000V megohmmeter. Locate and repair faulted DC conductor.

DC_OVER_VOLTAGE.title: DC Input Overvoltage
DC_OVER_VOLTAGE.description: DC input voltage on MPPT terminals exceeded the inverter maximum open-circuit voltage rating.
DC_OVER_VOLTAGE.oem_definition: DC_V register exceeded maximum rated DC input voltage limit.
potential_causes: Too many modules connected in series for cold weather temperature conditions
Severe DC voltage spike or external surge
DC_OVER_VOLTAGE.recommended_action: Measure open-circuit voltage (Voc) of each string immediately. Reconfigure string module count if over design limit.

SMB_COMM_FAULT.title: String Combiner Box Communication Fault
SMB_COMM_FAULT.description: Communication with DC String Monitoring Box (SMB) timed out.
SMB_COMM_FAULT.oem_definition: Logger detected RS485 communication timeout on SMB Modbus ID.
potential_causes: SMB auxiliary power supply offline
RS485 daisy-chain connection severed or loose terminal block
SMB_COMM_FAULT.recommended_action: Check 24V DC auxiliary power in SMB and verify RS485 communication lines.

SMB_STRING_FAULT.title: SMB DC String Disconnect / Blown Fuse
SMB_STRING_FAULT.description: SMB card detected blown DC fuse or zero-current deviation on active string.
SMB_STRING_FAULT.oem_definition: smb_error1 bitmask register indicated string channel error.
potential_causes: Blown gPV fuse inside combiner box
Disconnected MC4 plug or open-circuit string
Module diode failure
SMB_STRING_FAULT.recommended_action: Open SMB enclosure, check continuity across DC fuses, and measure open-circuit string voltage.
